attention_diagnostics.attention_formula: sum_(i<=t) sum_(r<=16) c_r(x_t) s_ti^r v_i, s_ti = Q_t K_i^T / sqrt(d_k); c_r(x_t) = tanh(x_t W_r + beta_r)/r! per layer/head, W initially zero, beta initially 0.549306144; x_t is the activation after the block input RMSNorm; every weight is multiplied by the prefactor f(s_ti) of the raw score s_ti = Q_t K_i^T / sqrt(d_k), f(s_ti) = softplus(s_ti) = log(1 + exp(s_ti)), evaluated as max(s_ti, 0) + log1p(exp(-|s_ti|)), then per-head RMSNorm over value channels with a learned gain; only the coefficient generator replaces x_t by h_t / max(||h_t||_2, 1e-6), where h_t is the raw attention input before shared pre-attention RMSNorm; no RMSNorm channel gain enters this coefficient input; Q/K/V retain RMSNorm(h_t); W remains trainable and unnormalized; each row evaluated in units e^(-m_t), m_t = M log max(1, max_i |z_ti|) over its transformed scores, a constant to differentiation, with the RMSNorm epsilon scaled by e^(-2 m_t): the same function, finite where z^M overflows FP32; head RMSNorm evaluated on each token and head's output divided by its largest magnitude, a constant to differentiation, with its epsilon divided by that magnitude's square (an output too small for that keeps its plain evaluation): the same function, with an FP32 gradient that is exact to rounding wherever FP32 holds the gradient itself (its elements are of size cotangent / output RMS, and FP32's normal range ends at 1.2e-38)
attention_diagnostics.attention_score_formula: exp(gamma_h) * <RoPE(g_Q * q / sqrt(mean(q^2) + eps)), RoPE(g_K * k / sqrt(mean(k^2) + eps))> / sqrt(d_K); independent Q/K channel gains per layer, shared across heads; gamma_h learned independently per layer/head, initially zero

generator_input.formula: x_hat = h / max(||h||_2, epsilon); z_j = W_j^T x_hat; h is the raw attention input before shared pre-attention RMSNorm; no RMSNorm channel gain enters the coefficient generator
